'''Tamazall''' was a location where the convicted criminals [[Biran Redben]] and [[M'dwello Di]] served 50 and 30 [[Standard year|year]] sentences respectively. The sentences were listed on the two criminals' profiles, which were among a number of profiles seen by [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] when she searched for that of the criminal [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14|the mention of Tamazall}}</ref> It was located in the [[Tamazall system]] in the [[Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]].<ref name="Appendix" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tamazall was mentioned on a screen in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tamazall/Legends|Tamazall]] was mentioned in the [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', written by [[Rick D. Stuart]].<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
